# Lane 2.238: the guard at start reads the fence itself

## Builders 1 and 2, fix rounds 1 and 2 (shortened)

- **What exists.** `checkLoginRole` (website, worker, `probe-logins`, `npm run test:real-postgres`) ends with `checkFence` (`packages/database/src/db/check-fence.ts`). It refuses, each with one mending statement: a league table not enabled and forced, or one the catalog lists missing or with its league column gone or renamed (T-470); a policy not the migrations' own word for word, or one of theirs missing; an unreviewed security-definer function the login may run (`reviewed-definers.ts`, T-469); any function the migrations made missing or changed: body, settings, owner, language, security, volatility (T-477); a relation they made missing or of another kind, owner or view definition (T-481); a relation no migration made in their schemas, or readable by the login elsewhere (T-476).
- **The catalog (T-468).** `migration-catalog.ts`, written by `npm run db:types` with the guard's own queries (`fence-catalog.ts`); `migration-catalog-file.test.ts` fails when it is stale.
- **Record 053's shape.** A worker start after pg-boss has made its tables is refused by T-60 alone (`reassign owned …` / `revoke queue_owner from app_login`), never "drop"; T-60 was not weakened; step 2.112 solves it.
- **Needs the founder (for STATUS):** in a session the founder started, the lead starts the website once against the test copy and reads any sentence naming a function in Supabase's own schemas, then revokes it or reviews it in.

## Fix round 3 and the closing (the second look's B, C and item 4), 2026-11-26

- **T-485.** The guard, and the catalog's generator, read everything in one read-only transaction with `set_config('search_path', '', true)` (`readQualified`), so every function prints with its schema; `rule()` no longer strips `public.`. The look's plant B (a `"$user"` schema `app_login` with its own `current_league_id()`) and the role variant (`alter role app_login set search_path = …`, fresh connection) are each refused by name; the login read league B meanwhile. The pinning test reads PostgreSQL 16's policies with an empty search path: all 36 equal PGlite 17's.
- **T-486.** The catalog lists 63 triggers (not foreign-key ones) on relations the migrations made, with `pg_get_triggerdef` and `tgenabled`, and their rules (none today; hashed). Refused: not listed (`drop trigger` / `drop rule … on …`), changed (drop, then the migrations' own definition), not enabled (`alter table … enable trigger …`), missing. The look's rule copying programs into `pgboss.c4`, and a definer trigger doing the same: the login read league B's row before the refusal.
- **T-482 tightened.** In `pgboss` only an ordinary table without a league column is let be; any view, materialized view or foreign table is refused (`revoke select …`, else `drop view`), never "drop table". A copy TABLE without a league column there cannot be told from pg-boss's own: step 2.112 (the queue's own owner; the login loses its reading of the schema) is what closes it.
- **T4.** The guard's promise is written beside T-60: it catches a by-hand change or drift of the fence, not a person holding the tables' owner's key who means harm. The T-60 line said the worker's login may change the job library's schema; the code refuses that; the line now says so.
- **Tests.** Embedded `check-fence.test.ts` +6 (32); real `fence-guard.test.ts` +6 (29). Breaks by hand, embedded one at a time: no empty search path (all 32 failed: the catalog is qualified), triggers not read, rules not read, enabled not compared, library views let be: each failed its own tests (with later ones in the file left planted). Real server, all at once (policy read stripping the schema, rules off, unlisted triggers let be, enabled off, library views let be): exactly the 6 new tests failed.
- **Merged `build/stage-1`** (2.225): no conflict, no migration arrived, the catalog regenerated unchanged.
- **Run, passed.** `npm run check`; `npm run typecheck`; db + isolation + worker (31 files, 553); `apps/web/src/server` whole (88 files, 1194, 226 s); role matrix (267); `npm run test:real-postgres` whole (9 files, 76); pending decisions (11, count unchanged); `npm run format:check`; `npm run test:web` (290); browser chunk `web-exit-test`, `admin-teams-on-database-test`, `demo-league-on-database-test`, `people-on-database-test`, `public-pages-on-database-test`, `activity-log-test`: all passed. Not run: the rest of the chain, `npm run verify`.
- **Guard's time on the real server, nothing planted:** 20 to 51 ms per call (21 calls; the first, opening the connection, 139 ms).
- **Pending decisions of the lane:** T-468, T-469, T-470, T-471, T-476, T-477, T-481, T-482, T-485, T-486.
- **Polish for the lead.** A listed table's columns, constraints and foreign keys are not compared (a same-name table of the same owner passes). Triggers and rules on relations outside the migrations' schemas (a definer trigger on `pgboss.job`) are not read. A function in the migrations' schemas that no migration made is not refused unless a policy, trigger or the definer check reaches it. View hashes are untested across 16 and 17 (no view today).
